findings_residual.title: No test in this change can fail from a regression in the code it ships - the four new tests pin only the server-side definition round-trip, so reverting polygonToGeoJson to getPath(), the listener release, or the vertex cap leaves all 30 tests green.
findings_residual.disposition: ACCEPTED as a documented gap, not fixed. The client half needs a Playwright spec; the harness exists (see below) but is not wired to this page and adding it is new scope on a hotfix. Follow-up warranted.

findings_residual.title: The 'no JS test runner in this repo' premise - carried from prep-context.notes and repeated in the test file - is FALSE. playwright.config.ts, tests/e2e/gl-kits.spec.ts and `npm run test:e2e` all exist (Playwright is simply not installed in node_modules right now).
findings_residual.disposition: FIXED post-gate: the test file comment now states the truth and names the harness. Comment-only, no behaviour change. prep-context.notes[1] is also wrong and should be corrected in the post-approval pass.

findings_residual.title: hydrateZips() silently drops ZIPs whose boundary fetch fails and then writes the truncated list into definition.zip_codes, permanently losing the ZIP on the next save.
findings_residual.disposition: PRE-EXISTING (:412-443); the lane scoped it honestly and did not deduct. This diff only swaps the click wiring at :436. Not fixed here - but exposure rises because this ticket makes editing ZIP-derived zones routine. Strong follow-up candidate.

findings_residual.title: Re-adding a previously detached ZIP silently restores the area the user just edited away (the detached polygon and the re-derived ZIP now overlap).
findings_residual.disposition: Not fixed - inherent to DETACH as specified by the operator. Worth surfacing in human QA.

findings_residual.title: The vertex cap makes AC4 unreachable for an unmeasured fraction of real ZCTAs, and a rejected selection writes a notice about ZIP B while ZIP A stays selected.
findings_residual.disposition: Accepted trade: an explained refusal beats a frozen tab. The fraction is unmeasured because tiger_data.zcta5_all is empty locally. Durable fix is ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology in searchZipCodes - separate ticket.

findings_residual.title: Zone::geoJsonHasValidRing() validates only the exterior ring, while this diff makes the client emit interior rings for the first time.
findings_residual.disposition: Checked: a 2-ring polygon saves cleanly (test_a_detached_boundary_keeps_its_interior_rings passes), so validation does not reject it. Hardening the validator is follow-up, not a blocker.
